description: This file extends the NodeAppModel class with functions related to resolving and managing URLs for A2 UI canvases and hosts, including normalization, connection state handling, and capability refreshes. It also defines an enum for tracking the readiness state of the UI.

classes.name: A2UIReadyState
classes.description: An enumeration representing the different states of readiness for the A2 UI, including confirmed ready, host not configured, and host unavailable.

methods.name: resolveCanvasHostURL
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the URL for the canvas host, trimming and validating the raw URL, and checking for loopback hosts.

methods.name: _test_resolveA2UIHostURL
methods.description: A test method that calls resolveA2UIHostURL asynchronously.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostURL
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the URL for the A2 UI host, similar to resolveCanvasHostURL but appends a specific path and query parameter.

methods.name: normalizeURLForTrustComparison
methods.description: Static method to normalize a URL string by lowercasing the scheme and host, and removing the fragment for trust comparison purposes.

methods.name: showA2UIOnConnectIfNeeded
methods.description: Displays the default A2 UI canvas on connection, ensuring UI is updated on the main thread.

methods.name: ensureA2UIReadyWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Ensures the A2 UI is ready, attempting URL resolution, refreshing capabilities if needed, and returning the readiness state.

methods.name: showLocalCanvasOnDisconnect
methods.description: Displays the default local canvas when disconnected.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostURLWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the A2 UI host URL, refreshing node capability if needed.

methods.name: resolveCanvasHostURLWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the canvas host URL, with capability refresh fallback.

methods.name: probeTCP
methods.description: Private static function to probe TCP connectivity to a URL's host and port within a timeout.
